verdict.rationale: Windmill exposes multiple programmatic paths (CLI `wmill`, git-sync auto-deploy, version-pinned webhooks, and an MCP server that lets LLM clients trigger scripts/flows) that together suggest an agent could manage workflows without the UI, and AI-generation docs show agents can edit items and reach a deploy step. However, the story specifically requires create/update/activate via the public API, and the evidence never surfaces a documented REST/OpenAPI spec (the openapi.json probe 404'd on all candidate paths) nor confirms MCP or CLI can create/activate flows rather than just trigger existing ones. missing for 10: explicit public API/OpenAPI docs for flow CRUD, confirmation that agent-driven creation/activation (not just triggering) works end-to-end without human deploy step.
